wayback._note: One domain, bvp.com, for every site generation. No era runs through wayback-pull.py: every parsed row carries its own capture URL (scratch/bvp-parse.py writes sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json). The Internet Archive stood in a machine-wide firewall cooldown at kickoff (2026-10-01 10:36 EDT, 60 min), so Common Crawl (scratch/cc-cluster.py, cc-fetch.py, key com,bvp)) carries 2008 on and the Internet Archive carries the years before 2008 (scratch/cdx-map.py, queued behind the cooldown), both through the machine-wide throttles.

roster._note: Provisional until the archived people namespaces are read; the roster is built by scratch/build-roster.py from first-party people pages (archived bvp.com team pages and the live Sanity team collection, alumni included) with investing titles only.

sources._note: The live portfolio: every `company` document (534) of the site's Sanity dataset (project 2e9xvz8g, production), read through the public query API by scratch/pull-sanity.py and flattened by scratch/shape-site.py. Per company the firm states a partnered year, a stage-partnered label, a status (active / public / acquired), its regions, sectors and the Bessemer team members on the deal.

site_api._note: bvp.com is Next.js over Sanity (project 2e9xvz8g); the dataset's query API answers without a token and serves company, bvpTeamMember, sector, memo, newsArticle, researchPost and the page documents (the About page carries the anti-portfolio).
site_api._entry_stage_note: stage_site (the CMS stagePartnered) is NOT in entry_stage_fields: 500 of 534 rows read 'seed', LinkedIn (a 2007 Series C entry) and HashiCorp among them, so the field is a migration default, not the firm's claim about the round it entered (decisions.md D7; scored in the run and recorded in scratch/stage-score.json). It stays in the evidence pack as an unscored extra. invest_year (partneredYear) is an anchor year.
site_api._team_note: Only the CMS role `investor` publishes (58 current people: partners, operating partners, vice presidents, investors). The roles `operatingAdvisor` (59 outside advisers) and `firmInfrastructure` (about 130 finance, legal, talent and assistant staff) are left unmapped on purpose, which keeps them out of the profile (COLLECTION.md s11: an unmapped group does not publish).
site_api._team_social_overrides_note: search_verified 2026-10-06 (Erik's ruling of 2026-09-30): each link came from a LinkedIn search whose result title names the person and the firm ('Michael Droesch - Bessemer Venture Partners', 'Sofia Guerra - Bessemer Venture Partners'), and each handle names the person. The firm's CMS carries no personal link for these two. Ten other current investors stay without a link (not searched): Alex Yuditski, Bhavik Nagda, Eric Kaplan, Felda Hardymon, Isha Yerramilli-Rao, Jason Scheller, Maha Malik, Marla Jalbut, Nithin Kaimal, Yael Schiff.

S-1 holder tables name the firm as 'entities affiliated with Bessemer Venture Partners' and its vehicles by their L.P. names; the general partners file as Deer <numeral> & Co.

desks._note: One registered adviser: Bessemer Venture Partners (Deer Management Co. LLC), CRD 159279, SEC 801-125875, principal office 1865 Palmer Avenue, Larchmont NY, no relying advisers; its Schedule D 7.B.(1) (ADV of 2026-05-13, data/filings/adv/159279.pdf) reports 54 private funds, $20.26B gross: Bessemer Venture Partners VI to XII with their Institutional and Associates vehicles, the Century Fund I and II (growth), the India and India II funds, BVP VII Special Opportunity Fund, the single-deal co-invest vehicles (Gator Co-Invest BE / LI / PA / TE / VE, Cloud All Star Fund, AN I, SG I) and BVP Forge (three vehicles). Fund XIII and Century Fund III filed their first Form Ds on 2026-09-14. Every entity was checked by its SEC filing address on 2026-10-01 (scratch/entity-addresses.json). Home desk (1865 Palmer Avenue, Larchmont; 1025 Old Country Road, Westbury, before about 1998; 889 Winslow Street, Redwood City): Bessemer Venture Partners I to XIII, Bessec Ventures IV and V (the Bessemer Securities parallel funds, filed from the firm's office with the Deer general partners), the Deer II to XII & Co. general partners, Deer Management Co., the Century and India funds, BVP VII Special Opportunity Fund, BVP VII E, the employee vehicles BVE 2001 / BVE 2001 Q / BIP 2001, 15 Angels I to III, GoBlue Ventures and Wahoowa Ventures (2021 Forms 3/4 from the firm's office), Cloud All Star Fund, Gator Co-Invest and Bessemer Venture Partners Enforta Cooperatief (a holding vehicle). Forge (same address, the buyout strategy, decisions.md D2): BVP Forge and BVP Forge II, partitioned as other_desk. External: Bessemer Trust and its adviser Bessemer Investment Management LLC (CRD 112215), Bessemer Group, the Old Westbury funds, Bessemer Securities Corp / LLC and Bessemer Ventures Inc (1271 Avenue of the Americas, the family office, decisions.md D3), Lindsay Goldberg & Bessemer (CRD 141029); and the 'BVP' namesakes: BVP III to VI Affiliates and Special Affiliates (Milwaukee and Chicago, Baird Venture Partners), BVP GP LLC (Skillman NJ, Battelle Ventures), the 'BVP <numeral> a Series of Bloom Opportunities Fund' vehicles (Delaware, 2025-26), BVP Fund 2 / Fund 3 (Incline Village NV), BVP Investors III and BVP III Investors Star 1 (Chicago), BVP LLC (New Buffalo MI), BVP Partners LLC (Ewing NJ), BVP XLVI LLC (Florida), BVP, LLC (Sioux Falls), BVP Europe II (Cayman, 2002, not identified as the firm's), BVP BBQ Blocker / Investors (62 Magnolia Avenue, Larchmont: not the firm's office), and the Deer Valley filers.

profile._note: focus_min_companies was set at kickoff (about 4.5% of the base then expected) and is kept. The crosswalk covers the 15 sector labels of the site's Sanity `sector` documents (14 of them sit on companies; Crypto is on none), filled 2026-10-06 (PRO-80 profile): 'Vertical' is the firm's vertical software practice and 'Enterprise' its enterprise software practice, both SaaS, as sixteen other books map 'Enterprise'; 'AI' is a cross-cutting tag the firm puts on 231 of its 534 listed companies, and the disagreement with the per-company focus column is flagged in investor/sources.json, not corrected here.
profile._socials_note: Link coverage 48 of 58 published investors (82.8%) on 2026-10-06: 46 from the firm's CMS, 2 search-verified (site_api.team_social_overrides). No exception is recorded because the floor of 80% is met.
